shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g '*lock*' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'components/**' -g 'README*' -g 'index.html' -g 'vite.config.*'"
/bin/bash -lc "ls -la && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' /home/sandbox 2>/dev/null"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat src/main.tsx && cat tsconfig.json && cat index.html && ls node_modules | head -35'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install react-markdown remark-gfm'
/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"for (const x of ['playwright','@playwright/test','puppeteer']) {try { console.log(x,import.meta.resolve(x)) } catch {}}\" && ls /tmp && git diff --stat"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install --prefix /tmp/listva-check playwright && /tmp/listva-check/node_modules/.bin/playwright install chromium'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && cat .gitignore && cat package.json'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i \"s/await page.locator('.markdown-preview a').getAttribute('href')?.startsWith('javascript:')/(await page.locator('.markdown-preview a').getAttribute('href'))?.startsWith('javascript:')/\" /tmp/listva-check/check.mjs
node /tmp/listva-check/check.mjs"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i \"s/headless:true,args/headless:true,executablePath:'\\/home\\/node\\/.cache\\/ms-playwright\\/chromium-1248\\/chrome-linux-arm64\\/chrome',args/\" /tmp/listva-check/check.mjs
node /tmp/listva-check/check.mjs"
/bin/bash -lc '/tmp/listva-check/node_modules/.bin/playwright install-deps chromium'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install --prefix /tmp/listva-check happy-dom'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build && git diff --check'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i 's/navigator:window.navigator,//' src/editor.check.test.tsx
npx vitest run src/editor.check.test.tsx --config vitest.check.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -i \"s/expect(container.querySelector('.markdown-preview strong')?.textContent).toBe('текст');/expect(container.querySelector('.markdown-preview')?.textContent).toContain('текст');/\" src/editor.check.test.tsx
npx vitest run src/editor.check.test.tsx --config vitest.check.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc 'rm src/editor.check.test.tsx vitest.check.config.ts
npx --yes prettier --write src/App.tsx src/styles.css index.html'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build && git diff --check && git status --short'
